blocks.html:
This method marks a payment collection as paid. It sends a request to the 
[Mark as Paid](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#payment-collections\_postpaymentcollectionsidmarkaspaid)
API route.

The API route creates and authorizes a payment session, then capture its payment.
It uses the manual payment provider by default, or the provider passed in
`provider_id` to record the captured payment under a specific provider.

types.name: id
types.description: The payment collection to mark as paid.

types.name: body
types.description: The details to mark the payment collection as paid.

children.name: order_id
children.description: The ID of the order this payment collection belongs to.

children.name: provider_id
children.description:
The ID of the payment provider to record the captured payment under.
Defaults to the system (manual) payment provider when omitted.

types.name: query
types.description: Configure the fields to retrieve in the payment collection.

children.name: fields
children.description:
The fields and relations to retrieve separated by commas.

Learn more in the [API reference](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/store#select-fields-and-relations).

types.name: headers
types.description: Headers to pass in the request.

children.name: tags
children.description:
Tags to cache data under for Next.js applications.

Learn more in [Next.js's documentation](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/caching#fetch-optionsnexttags-and-revalidatetag).

children.name: id
children.description: The ID of the payment collection.

children.name: currency_code
children.description: The ISO 3 character currency code of the payment sessions and payments associated with payment collection.

children.name: amount
children.description: The total amount to be authorized and captured.

children.name: authorized_amount
children.description: The amount authorized within the associated payment sessions.

children.name: captured_amount
children.description: The amount captured within the associated payment sessions.

children.name: refunded_amount
children.description: The amount refunded within the associated payments.

children.name: completed_at
children.description: When the payment collection was completed.

children.name: created_at
children.description: When the payment collection was created.

children.name: updated_at
children.description: When the payment collection was updated.

children.name: metadata
children.description: Holds custom data in key-value pairs.

children.name: status
children.description: The status of the payment collection.
